suites.name: root pytest unit tests (fast tier)
suites.notes: The gate's suite (ARB-046): every test except those marked slow. Fast enough to run on every commit.

suites.name: root pytest slow tier
suites.notes: Tests marked slow: a real external analyzer through the adapters, or a scan beyond the fixtures. CI's slow-tier job in pr-check.yml runs it with the analyzers installed; the gate does not.
